newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek rates ease on short ecu, long drs positions.
newsitem.headline: Greek rates ease on short ecu, long drs positions.

text.p: Greek money rates were softer in late dealing with downward bias more accentuated in the short end on the opening of new short ECU, long drachma positions at the forex.

"Money rates are softer in late trade with the drop in short rates being bigger than in longer tenors," a money market dealer at a foreign bank said. "The market perception is that liquidity has improved on forex inflows."
About 80 million ecus were sold at the central bank's fixing and another 50 million ecus after the fixing, dealers said.

"Some dealers play ecu/drachma on expectations that the central bank will not allow the drachma to slide much against the rising dollar which puts a floor on ecu/drachma at lower levels," a dealer at a foreing bank said.
The Bank of Greece soaked overnight money at an unchanged 12.40 percent.
"We are bound to see some nervousness as elections near," said a dealer at another foreign bank.

A nationwide poll released on Sunday showed that the conservatives held a narrow lead over the socialists. The conservative New Democracy party had 31 percent of the vote against 30.6 percent for the socialist PASOK party.
The Left Coalition party had 4.2 percent in the opinion poll and the splinter socialist DIKKI party 6.0 percent, with 6.5 percent of the voters being undecided.
Simitis was retaining his popularity in the poll getting 48.9 percent with Evert improving his image and receiving 36.4 percent.
The poll conducted by the private MRB polling company had a margin of error of 2.0 percent. Greece's electorate law favours heavily the first party after the vote.
Another poll put the socialists slightly ahead of the conservatives by 32.8 percent to 31.9 percent.
Early elections will be held September 22 but the market has taken a positive attitude towards them on the grounds that the winner will have no option but to follow Greece's EU convergence plan.
The mark was quoted at 159.44/49 drachmas from Monday's 159.490 fix, the dollar at 237.58/68 drachmas from 238.010 and the Ecu at 301.08/18 from 301.230 drachmas.
